ValidationRule.description: For CAC Executive Escalations, the fields Contact, Country, Customer ID, Account ID, Category and Sub Category are required. For reference,check user story #27296 on Gitlab Refined rule #27569
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations", OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c), ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Country__c ,""), (AND(ISBLANK( ContactId ),Is_IM_Employee__c = False)), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , '' ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , '' )), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Customer - On Hold"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Internal - On Hold"), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Monitor Solution") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: (Contact Name or Is IM Employee checked), Country, Account Name, Customer ID, Category and Sub Category are required
